name: agent-status
description: Hooks that tell the terminal whether the agent is working, idle or waiting on a question, for the web UI's status dots on a session that runs in a terminal (a chat's bridge reports it itself), and post to a webhook when it goes idle or needs you.

settings.label: Webhook
settings.description: URL that gets a JSON POST when the agent goes idle or needs you; the format is the webhook type's. The agent can read it.

settings.label: Webhook type
settings.description: generic: {text, content, project, run_id, status}, which Slack, Mattermost and Discord show. google-chat: {text} alone, for a Google Chat space's incoming webhook.
